title: El mercado y el Estado
goal: Read how 1990s reforms moved away from the statist model toward a market-driven one with lower tariffs, more independent central banks, and active courting of foreign investment.

items: Describe the state's role under the earlier statist model.
Explain what neoliberal reforms proposed instead.
Describe how many countries gave central banks more independence from the executive.
Describe the shift in attitude toward foreign investment.
Use frente a to contrast two models or positions.
